title: Gateway guide: codec and media negotiation
description: Section on handling the boundary between JMAP VTC's media-agnostic model and gateways' codec-aware signaling. SDP offer/answer for SIP. H.245 OLC for H.323. Transcoding decisions at the gateway. mediaTypes alignment (VTCCall mediaTypes vs gateway-negotiated codecs). None of this is JMAP VTC's concern, but gateway implementers need to understand the boundary.
